facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service
facts.title: potential incident during a statutory inspection on PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 26 December 2021 a potential incident was recorded on PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
